note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An exposure stops the exposure work and goes through the employer's referral procedure.
Comcare's clean-up PPE list includes rubber-soled shoes, gloves, hats, sun protection and high-visibility vests.

practicalCriteria: The learner records each exposure route and the control for it.
The learner suspends exposure work until controls and hygiene facilities exist.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Hygiene facilities or exposure controls are not in place.
